Familiaridade com normas internacionais de segurança offshore (IMO, SOLAS, API RP 75).

Português fluente.

Contrato temporário com possibilidade de extensão conforme desempenho e demanda do projeto.

title: Azure devops engineer
description:
About you
You are a senior-level Dev Ops Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You’re comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experiencein senior or staff-level Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
Professional certifications such asAzure Dev Ops, Terraform , or similar (preferred).
Hands-on experience withTerraformand automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent).
Strong proficiency withAzure services,including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure Open AI.
Experience with c ontainerization and orchestration technologies(Docker, Kubernetes).
Deep expertise in identity and access management, includingMicrosoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
Advanced skills inCI/CD automationusingGit Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops , and related toolchains.
Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, Power Shell, and/or Python.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:
Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, Postgre SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions and Azure Dev Ops. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote Dev Ops culture, automation, and continuous improvement.Additional Information

title: Lower school makerspace teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).
The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. As an IB World School, we are looking for an educator who can seamlessly integrate maker-centered learning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP) curriculum. Working closely with classroom teachers and specialists, this educator will design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based projects that nurture innovation, design thinking, a maker mindset, and strong foundations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) for students from Kindergarten to Grade 5.
The ideal candidate is:
Holds a Bachelor's degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects. If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Data architect - analista pleno
description:
Descrição do perfil
Responsável por construir, otimizar e manter modelos conceituais e lógicos de banco de dados.Principais atividades
Apoiar em desenhos de soluções em escalas e plataformas capazes de gerenciar grandes quantidades de dados, estruturados e não estruturados, mesmo em modo de real time, através da escolha correta de arquiteturas de referência;
Colaborar com uma arquitetura de dados horizontal que fomente o reuso de soluções por diversas áreas da companhia otimizando os custos de implantação e de operação;
Desenhar soluções que garantam toda a governança, privacidade e qualidade dos dados;
Apoiar nas aplicações de políticas da empresa em termos de privacidade e segurança no acesso aos dados;
Descrever as tecnologias específicas em termos de integração entre componentes e fluxos lógicos de interação;
Observar as tendências tecnológicas emergentes e dar indicações sobre as melhores práticas;
Colaborar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria por meio de integrações e substituições de sistemas legados;
Desenvolver protótipos e proof of concept em projetos de inovação;
Contribuir com a disseminação de uma cultura de Data-Driven Decision na companhia, fazendo interface entre áreas técnicas e as diversas áreas de negócio.Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação
Conhecimento sobre pipeline de dados e todas as suas fases, desde a ingestão até tomada de decisão;
Conhecimento técnico de estruturas de dados (Bancos Relacionais, Não Relacionais e Big Data);
Conhecimento de soluções de nuvem, especialmente em Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
Experiência na arquitetura de dados, especialmente em ambientes GCP e Azure;
Conhecimento em linguagens de programação (SQL, Shell Script, Python, Java, etc.);
Ferramentas de visualização e exploração de dados (Power BI, Tableau, SAS, Data Studio etc);
Metodologias desenvolvimento lean/agile;
Experiência na coleta e análise de requisitos do sistema;
Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Advogado(a) pleno
description:
Na Ecopetrol Brasil, nosso compromisso é fornecer energia que transforme o futuro, alinhando desenvolvimento sustentável e inovação tecnológica. Somos parte de um grupo integrado de energia com operações globais, que abrange desde a exploração e produção de hidrocarbonetos até transporte, refinaria e comercialização. Além disso, estamos presentes em negócios de biocombustíveis e infraestruturas essenciais. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.Junte-se à Ecopetrol Brasil!Estamos buscando um(a)Advogado(a) Plenopara atuar em modelohíbrido , em nosso escritório localizado emBotafogo – RJ.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Assessorar a empresa em questões regulatórias junto à ANP, CNPE, MME e demais órgãos reguladores;
Apoiar na condução de processos administrativos regulatórios, incluindo cessões, atualizações cadastrais, submissão de documentos e diligências junto à ANP;
Analisar, revisar e elaborar contratos típicos do setor, como JOAs, SPAs, contratos de consórcio, concessão e partilha de produção, GSAs, GTAs, MOUs;
Revisar e aprimorar contratos corporativos padrão, manuais, políticas internas, mitigando riscos jurídicos;
Elaborar e revisar documentos legais e regulatórios do setor, incluindo licenças, certidões, contratos de exploração e produção e pareceres sobre normas de órgãos reguladores;
Preparar documentação para inscrição e qualificação em licitações e leilões da ANP, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos;
Prestar suporte legal contínuo às áreas corporativas, garantindo conformidade regulatória e corporativa;
Participar de fóruns da indústria, interagir com órgãos reguladores e apoiar na interface com escritórios de advocacia externos;
Apoiar controles internos e auditorias jurídicas, regulatórias e corporativas;
Identificar riscos legais e regulatórios, propor soluções preventivas e monitorar mudanças na legislação aplicável à indústria de exploração e produção.Requisitos e qualificações:Graduação em Direito;
Atuação comprovada em contratos corporativos;
Desejável experiência e conhecimento na indústria de óleo e gás;
Inglês avançado/fluente;
Espanhol será considerado diferencial.Conhecimentos técnicos:Sólido conhecimento da legislação brasileira, especialmente societária e corporativa;
Desejável conhecimento das normas e regulamentações aplicáveis à indústria de E&P;
Habilidade de análise, síntese e antecipação de riscos jurídicos e regulatórios.

title: Analista de inteligência de negócios sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;
Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com foco nos indicadores operacionais Identificar, estruturar e priorizar alavancas de resultado, avaliando impacto, viabilidade e retorno financeiro;
Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada como Analista em áreas estratégicas;
Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;
Experiência na construção de recomendações estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva;
Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).Informações adicionais:

title: Latam-focused research intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group
Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.Workplace:Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-siteContract Type:InternshipPosition Description
We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus onLatin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.
The selected candidate must benative orfluent in Spanish and English (mandatory)and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.Please note:Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.Main Responsibilities
·Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.
·Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.
·Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.
·Track the performance and movements of financial assets.
·Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.
·Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.
·Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.
·Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.Requirements
·Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).
·Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.
·Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.
·Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.
·Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.
·Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).
·Clear and structured written communication skills.
·Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.Differentials
·Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.
·Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.
·Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).Benefits
·Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.
·Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in Lat Am.
·Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.
·Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Analista operações - rio de janeiro/rj, first mile
description:
Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando por um/uma Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de gestão e monitoramento de coletas de sellers.O/A Analista de Transporte - First Mile atua em uma escala 5x2 em revezamento de turnos. É responsável por monitorar o desempenho e a conformidade dos transportadores da operação de coleta (inbound), em coordenação com times internos e externos. Também é responsável por apoiar os lançamentos de novos parceiros logísticos de coleta. O trabalho exige alguém que tenha grande disposição para assumir responsabilidades, tenha habilidades para identificar padrões e tendências, juntamente com a capacidade de examinar detalhes e analisar dados, aprofundando-se nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais e propondo soluções. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função. Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJTipo de atuação: PresencialEscala: 5x2Key job responsibilities- Gerir a operação de coleta e entrega de pacotes de Marketplace na Amazon Logística;- Monitorar diariamente, hora-hora a operação de coleta dos parceiros logísticos de coleta, resolvendo problemas operacionais para garantia das coletas no prazo;- Gerir problemas diários junto os transportadores de forma colaborativa e construtiva, identificar oportunidades de melhoria no processo de ponta a ponta e identificar melhorias na área; - Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas no dia-a-dia operacional.- Gerir, analisar e melhorar as métricas de performance;- Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais; - Responder os tickets abertos pelos vendedores parceiros em relação a temas da coleta;- Apresentar métricas para clientes internos e externos – comunicação frequente com os mesmos em busca de soluções operacionais de coleta; - Servir de elo de ligação entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;- Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos no dia-a-dia;
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering- Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários parceiros de coleta simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes de sua estação;- Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados;- MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);- Português fluente;- Experiência em Logística, Transporte;- Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% presencial;
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Inglês intermediário;- Excelentes habilidades de Comunicação - lidar com transportadoras como stakeholders/clientes;- Conhecimentos de Last Mile e e Commerce;- Experiência anterior no acompanhamento de processos e análises, métricas e resolução de problemas;- A pessoa deve estar disposta a trabalhar de forma independente;

title: Banco de talentos 2026
description:
Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão? Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros. 
Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil! O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.
O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.
Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?
Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu… Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.
Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!
RAÇA… Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência! …AMOR E PAIXÃO! Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer! CRAQUE FAZEMOS EM CASA Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família! Venha fazer parte dessa equipe! /n/n

title: Master data modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM Info Sphere Data Architect, SAP Power Designer, or similar tools.
Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or My SQL.
Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Data architect (data modeling & optimization)
description:
About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
Strong proficiency using Git Hub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.
Additional Information About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Operational excellence associate
description:
Position Summary A critical aspect of Oceaneering’s culture is the desire to create value, speed, and agility in the manner in which we service customers and internal stakeholders. The Operational Excellence Associate is responsible for supporting business partners with the development, implementation and ongoing management of their long-term strategy and objectives and execution on Operational Excellence projects.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
In conjunction with the Operational Excellence Master or Practitioner, provide diagnostics of the business group or function throughout the year to identify potential Operational Excellence projects
Using Lean, DMAIC or other improvement methodologies, identify critical processes and controls necessary to meet business objectives
Implement and drive continuous improvement within the business group or function
Provide hands on utilization, implementation of Operational Excellence tools and concepts to identify areas for improvement that can accelerate business results, reduce COPQ and improve execution
Support or oversee the preparation and facilitation of Kaizen events
Assess, improve and develop the Operational Excellence knowledge, skills and abilities of the business group or function so they can incorporate Operational Excellence principles, concepts, and tools into their day to day activities and processes
Maintain KPIs for quality, productivity costs, and service delivery such as first-time quality, on time delivery, or efficiency improvements
Participate in or support high-profile – high-visibility projects using LSS, Agile, and/or project management methodologies
Qualifications:
Must be Fluent in English
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Finance, Accounting, or equivalent
Experience in process improvement and project leadership such as the following:
Lean Six Sigma applications, to process redesign and improvement
Awareness or experience in Operational Excellence principles and practices including project management and agile methodologies
Ability and desire to achieve Green Belt to Lean Bronze certification
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior azure cloud architect
description:
About You You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams.
You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
Strong experience with Azure Dev Ops, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.

title: Junior business analyst
description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You’ll work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.  
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You’ll also have the opportunity to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. Some examples of the specific work may include interviewing clients, leading client teams, building financial models, and working with Mc Kinsey subject experts to develop perspectives and insights for the client. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site. 
When you join Mc Kinsey, you are joining a firm that will invest in your professional development. You will participate in an introductory training program, as well as a range of social activities to get to know your office and the firm. 
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will receive training and coaching on how to better:

Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them
Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods
Work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act
Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations
Communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner
Develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values Mc Kinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include: 

Engagement colleagues and leadership who will provide feedback regularly to help you improve your daily performance
A professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams
A senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals At the end of your Junior Business Analyst program, you may receive an offer to become a Business Analyst.
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office to work in teams and directly with our clients. This 6 to 24-month program was created to develop talents into real leaders through research, training, mentoring, and coaching sessions. 
Your team colleagues will make you feel welcome and help you be at your best during client engagements. The Professional Development team will complement your experience by tailoring a learning and training program for you, considering your strengths and development needs. 
In this role you will have the opportunity to work on teams and help the best organizations in the world – across the private, public, and social sectors – solve some of their most difficult problems, while you discover coaches, mentors, sponsors and friends in your learning program.

Undergraduate degree in any course, except business administration, economics and engineering
Graduation between Dec 2022 and Jul 2026
Ability to communicate ideas most effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and Portuguese
Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
Capability to drive an independent workstream in the context of a broader team project
Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
Comfort with ambiguous, ever-changing situations

title: Senior key account executive
description:
1. About Us
Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. Guided by our core belief—“We help people eat better, live better” —we’re bringing innovation to the global stage and building a better future for consumers and partners alike.
2. Responsibilities
Responsible for managing and developing assigned accounts, supporting medium-sized chain brands to strengthen cooperation with the platform through brand marketing and promotional activities, contributing to the growth of transaction volume; executing the company’s sales strategy and supporting the achievement of sales targets;
Understand the business operations of the brands under responsibility based on their industry characteristics, and assist in developing and implementing food delivery solutions through basic business data analysis;
Maintain effective communication with the platform’s delivery team, acting as a liaison between the delivery team and assigned brands to help improve the overall delivery service experience;
Actively collect first-hand marketing information, user feedback, and local market insights, and provide practical and actionable suggestions to support business improvements. 3. Basic Requirements
3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development in the food, restaurant, or consumer goods industry is preferred;
Good negotiation and market development skills, strong goal orientation, customer-focused mindset, and willingness to take on challenges;
Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in office software applications; experience working with reports and charts is required;
High level of integrity, responsibility, resilience, and teamwork; proactive and passionate about work;
English is mandatory.
4. Why Join Us?
Be part of the global expansion of Meituan’s food delivery revolution. At Keeta, you’ll experience firsthand the fast-paced growth and transformation of a cutting-edge industry. Join a diverse, world-class team that encourages bold thinking and global collaboration. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Gerente de loja
description:
A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.
Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.
Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.
Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!
Como Será Seu Dia a Dia Aqui Reportando-se ao Supervisor Regional, sua principal responsabilidade será promover a venda de produtos CK, atingindo o volume de vendas previsto, visando à conquista de novos clientes e a fidelização dos clientes atuais.

Fazer a gestão completa da loja, incluindo pessoas, processos e produtos.

Responsável por manter o clima favorável às atividades de venda, garantindo a implementação, execução e repasse das informações para todos os colaboradores, através das normas e procedimentos da empresa. Habilidades e Requisitos

title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:
About You
You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.
Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

Professional proficiency in English.

title: Nurse offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore
Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;
Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;
Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;
Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;
Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);
Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;
Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;
Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;
Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;
Provide First Aid training to designated first aid teams onboard;
Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);
Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.
Requirements
Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced life support and emergency care training;
Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;
Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

Desejável experiência e conhecimento na indústria de óleo e gás;

Desejável conhecimento das normas e regulamentações aplicáveis à indústria de E& P;
Habilidade de análise, síntese e antecipação de riscos jurídicos e regulatórios.

title: Estágio confeitaria
description:
ESTÁ GIO EM CONFEITARIA
No Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel — um dos hotéis mais icônicos do mundo, reconhecido como o 11º melhor do planeta e o melhor da América do Sul pelo ranking The World’s 50 Best Hotels 2025 — cada criação é feita com propósito e paixão. O que esperamos de você:

Colaborar na criação e preparo de sobremesas, massas e doces.
Auxiliar na montagem e finalização, garantindo o padrão da apresentação, sabor e harmonia em cada detalhe;

Praticar os mais altos padrões de segurança de alimentos, higiene e aproveitamento responsável dos insumos;

Ter conhecimento das normas de Segurança de Alimentos;
Disponibilidade para estagiar das 08h00 às 15h00 ou das 15h00 às 22h00.
Paixão por confeitaria e por gastronomia.
Comprometido, curiosidade e dedicação, com desejo genuíno de evoluir em um ambiente de excelência.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos.
Vale-transporte - abrangente para todas as modalidades: metrô, ônibus e trem.

Alimentação no local.
Seguro de Vida
Folga de Aniversário
Escala 5 x 2
Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa.
De acordo com o seu “tempo de casa”, você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da Belmond ao redor do mundo, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas.
Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.
Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje!

Nós do Copacabana Palace, somos orgulhosos em fazer parte da LVMH e da coleção global de hotéis, trens e cruzeiros fluviais Belmond, todos criando experiências excepcionais em todo o mundo. Quando você se junta à nossa propriedade, você se torna parte de uma família global de hotéis ricos em história e destinos deslumbrantes, onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) estão no centro da experiência Belmond.

title: Senior azure cloud architect
description:
About You
You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams.
You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
Strong experience with Azure Dev Ops, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
Design and maintain multi-stage Azure Dev Ops pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
Collaborate with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Experience with Azure Dev Ops and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
Advanced English proficiency.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Data architect (data modeling & optimization)
description:
About You
You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
Strong proficiency using Git Hub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Position Summary
A critical aspect of Oceaneering’s culture is the desire to create value, speed, and agility in the manner in which we service customers and internal stakeholders. In conjunction with the Operational Excellence Master or Practitioner, provide diagnostics of the business group or function throughout the year to identify potential Operational Excellence projects
Using Lean, DMAIC or other improvement methodologies, identify critical processes and controls necessary to meet business objectives

Must be Fluent in English

Experience in process improvement and project leadership such as the following:
Lean Six Sigma applications, to process redesign and improvement
Awareness or experience in Operational Excellence principles and practices including project management and agile methodologies
Ability and desire to achieve Green Belt to Lean Bronze certification
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

description:
Sobre a DTXA DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.
Sobre o trabalho
Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de engenharia.
O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação técnica de futuros engenheiros especialistas em trem de pouso em processos de MRO.
O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de \"job rotation\" para que possa aprender sobre o processo de trens de pouso de forma global.
1. Suporte de projeto e engenharia
Tarefas:
Apoiar os engenheiros na análise e revisão das especificações do projeto.
Auxiliar na avaliação de desenhos, esquemas e especificações para componentes do trem de pouso.
Saiber como as equipes de engenharia dão suporte ao processo de produção e manutenção.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Compreensão dos princípios de design para componentes aeroespaciais
Familiaridade com software CAD e desenhos de engenharia
Técnicas de resolução de problemas em engenharia aeroespacial
2. Análise de Tensão e Teste de Material
Tarefas de rotação:
Auxiliar em cálculos de análise de tensão ou simulações para componentes do trem de pouso.
Participar de testes de materiais, como testes de tração, fadiga e corrosão.
Observar o uso da Análise de Elementos Finitos (FEA) para componentes do trem de pouso.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Princípios básicos de estresse, tensão e ciência dos materiais
Uso de ferramentas de simulação (por exemplo, FEA)
Aplicação de testes de materiais em engenharia aeronáutica
3. Conformidade Regulatória e Documentação
Tarefas:
Saber mais sobre o papel dos órgãos reguladores (FAA, ANAC, EASA...) nas operações de MRO.
Auxiliar na documentação dos procedimentos de manutenção, inspeção e reparo.
Entender como manter a conformidade com os padrões de aeronavegabilidade.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Familiaridade com normas e certificações regulatórias
Sistemas de gerenciamento e rastreamento de documentação
Atenção aos protocolos de conformidade e aeronavegabilidade
4. Gestão e Coordenação de Projetos
Tarefas:
Acompanhar os gerentes de projeto para entender o agendamento e a alocação de recursos.
Auxiliar no gerenciamento de cronogramas e documentação de projetos para projetos de revisão de trens de pouso.
Ajudar na coordenação entre as equipes de produção, engenharia e qualidade.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo e coordenação de projetos
Compreensão das ferramentas e técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos
Comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental
5. Suporte de campo e interação com o cliente
Tarefas:
Auxiliar na prestação de suporte técnico aos clientes (companhias aéreas, militares, etc.) quando necessário.
Observar as visitas dos clientes e ajude a explicar os processos de reparo.
Participar da análise de causa raiz para problemas recorrentes de trem de pouso.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Habilidades de comunicação com o cliente em um contexto técnico
Resolução de problemas e análise de causa raiz
Coordenação entre engenharia e atendimento ao cliente

title: Master data modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location
Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM Info Sphere Data Architect, SAP Power Designer, or similar tools.
Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or My SQL.
Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Remote ai quality analyst (portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.
Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying " Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.
Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months
After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.
Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Site manager (projetos industriais)
description:

Definir e coordenar a matriz de riscos dos elementos de obras industriais, antecipando falhas potenciais em interfaces disciplinares, riscos de montagem mecânica, riscos de segurança operacional, desvios de performance dos equipamentos e impactos financeiros;

Compatibilizar o projeto com o escopo contratual, analisando a viabilidade das metodologias de montagem, interligações de sistemas e sequenciamento construtivo, otimizando soluções técnicas para reduzir custos, retrabalhos e riscos de parada ou atraso de startup;
Atuar em parceria com Suprimentos na especificação técnica e aquisição de materiais e equipamentos, buscando fornecedores internacionais, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade normativa, custo-benefício e gestão eficiente de estoque e entregas;
Aplicar conhecimentos das principais modalidades contratuais utilizadas em obras industriais, desenhando estratégias adequadas para cada contexto e suas interfaces multidisciplinares, mantendo profundo conhecimento do contrato;
Elaborar e sustentar reinvindicações (claims) e aditivos, quando necessário, visando a manutenção do equilíbrio contratual e a proteção dos indicadores de performance do projeto;
Realizar a gestão contratual rigorosa com subcontratados, assegurando cumprimento de obrigações técnicas, regulatórias e de SMS, mitigando passivos e garantindo medições precisas, rastreáveis e conformes ao avanço físico real;
Compreender o desempenho econômico-financeiro de projetos industriais, analisando CAPEX, OPEX, curva S integrada por disciplina, impactos de equipamentos estratégicos e variações cambiais em contratos internacionais.
Manter relacionamento transparente com sindicatos, órgãos reguladores, Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos ambientais e auditorias técnicas, garantindo observância à legislação trabalhista, NR’s e normas industriais aplicáveis, preservando a segurança empresarial;
Priorizar a Segurança do Trabalho desde as fases de engenharia até a execução, implantando cultura de intolerância a acidentes, gestão de energias perigosas, análises de risco operacionais e práticas avançadas de controle de processo;
Coordenar atividades de pré-comissionamento e completação mecânica, desenvolve planos e procedimentos de comissionamento, manuais de operação e manutenção, matrizes de testes e controles rigorosos de qualidade e riscos operacionais;
Planejar e gerenciar a partida da planta industrial, coordenando testes operacionais, energização de sistemas elétricos, calibração de instrumentos, testes de performance e integração com a equipe de operação, garantindo entrega segura e funcional ao cliente.
Perfil Requerido:
Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Elétrica, Produção ou correlatas;
Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
Sólida experiência como Site Manager em obras do ramo industrial, sobretudo em plantas químicas e/ou petroquímicas;
Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Fast, reliable turnaround times
Clear, professional communication
Familiarity with tools like Descript, Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, Logic, or similar

Proficiency in Audio Editing, including cleaning, trimming, and fine-tuning audio files

Knowledge of Sound and Music production basics to seamlessly incorporate them into content
Strong Editing skills paired with attention to detail to maintain high-quality output

title: Analista de inteligência de negócios sênior

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;
Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com foco nos indicadores operacionais Identificar, estruturar e priorizar alavancas de resultado, avaliando impacto, viabilidade e retorno financeiro;
Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada como Analista em áreas estratégicas;
Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;
Experiência na construção de recomendações estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva;
Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).
